reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text: Nat that good, it cuz a white things if you touch the hair after applying the treatment
reviews.zh: 唔係咁好，因為如果塗完護理之後摸頭髮，會有啲白色嘅嘢。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text:
I first tried the Unove hair cream and I loved it so much that I decided to buy the hair mascara from the same brand. I’m really impressed with it!

It works like a little styling tool — I just run it over a strand of hair, and it smooths everything down, almost like a light hairspray. My hair stays neat, doesn’t get frizzy, and the strands don’t separate or stick out in different directions.

I’m very happy with this product. The Unove brand really surprised me, and now I want to try more of their hair care products!
reviews.zh:
我先試咗 Unove 嘅髮霜，非常鍾意，所以決定買同一品牌嘅 hair mascara（髮睫毛膏）。我真係好欣賞呢件產品！

佢好似一件小造型工具咁——我只係喺一撮頭髮上掃過，就可以將所有頭髮壓平，效果好似輕微定型噴霧咁。我嘅頭髮保持得整整齊齊，唔會起毛，髮絲亦唔會散開或者向唔同方向翹起。

我對呢款產品好滿意。Unove 品牌真係令我大感驚喜，而家我想試吓佢哋嘅其他護髮產品！

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text: Simplemente Fabuloso! Lo llevo a todas partes, pero no por que necesite pasar retoques, alcotrario desde su primer uso es más que suficiente para el día entero!
reviews.zh: 簡直超讚！我到處都帶住佢，但唔係因為要補妝，相反，由第一次用開始已經夠用成日！

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text: My daughter's favorite hair finishing stick from Unove it smells good no white cast and the hair remain neat and clean without being oily. I recommend it .
reviews.zh: 係我女兒最鍾意嘅 Unove 髮型定型棒。味道好好聞，唔會留白，頭髮保持整齊乾淨，又唔會油膩。我推薦。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text:
The scent is really nice. I've been using it for a while now and it's really something i have in my bag. It stays for a long while and it doesn't make your hair look greasy at all.

I love it
reviews.zh:
味道好好聞。我用咗一段時間，佢已經係我袋入面必備嘅嘢。效果可以維持好耐，而且唔會令頭髮睇落油膩。

我好鍾意。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text: First time using it, love using it. It really fix my flying hair, it does last long periods. Absolutely I will buy again. Smells amazing, does not leave residue to hair, not sticky , not oily.
reviews.zh: 第一次用就好鍾意。佢真係可以壓住我飛起嚟嘅頭髮，效果亦可以維持好耐。我一定會再買！味道超好聞，唔會喺頭髮上留低殘留物，唔會黏，亦唔會油膩。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text:
Works really well. I like the size of the brush. Little goes a long way so it lasts a long time - I use it about 3x a week and I’ve used it for 2 months. Works all day as long as it’s not too windy. I need to dip for left side and dip again for right side. It doesn’t leave your hair hard like hair spray. Smells really nice too.

My favorite frizz control tool.
reviews.zh:
效果好好。我好鍾意佢嘅刷頭大細。少少已經夠用好耐，所以可以用好耐——我每星期用大約三次，已經用咗兩個月。只要風唔係太大，成日都有效。我要左邊沾一次，右邊再沾一次。佢唔會令頭髮變得好硬，唔似髮膠咁。味道都好好聞。

係我最鍾意嘅控毛躁工具。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Frizz-Calming Sleek Hair Finishing Stick 10ml
reviews.text: It's really good! I used it before my dance class, and it held well for a rather intense class. I only needed to fix up a little at the end but it's good nonetheless.
reviews.zh: 真係好好！我喺跳舞班之前用咗，佢喺一堂幾激烈嘅課程中都保持得好好。最後我只需要稍微補少少，不過都係好用嘅。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
